info.title: Simple Host API
info.description: Static website hosting with a light per-site backend. Deploy a site with one API call — inline JSON files (LLM-friendly) or a tar.gz/zip archive — and each site gets shared JSON state (with atomic ops), append-only collections, optional password (view-lock) protection, and starter templates. Sign-in is a 6-digit email code or Google/GitHub that returns an API key, sent as the `X-API-Key` header. Hosted-page sign-in uses the same account but a site-scoped session cookie — never an API key.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Email-code sign-in and dashboard OAuth handoff (`/?token=`)

tags.name: Visitor
tags.description: Site-scoped browser session for hosted-page Google/GitHub sign-in. Same `users` row as email-code / dashboard OAuth; the cookie is not an API key and does not satisfy owner routes.

tags.name: Deploy

get.summary: Skills hub catalog — discover the bundled agent skills
get.description: Public catalog of the skills this server bundles (name + description + fetch URL), so any agent can search them over HTTP. No auth.
Returns the raw SKILL.md for the named skill. Public, no auth.

get.summary: Fetch one of a skill's reference documents (markdown)
get.description: A skill's SKILL.md routes to reference documents under its references/ directory. A folder install has them on disk; install methods that fetch only SKILL.md by URL do not, so SKILL.md cites each reference by absolute URL as well and this endpoint serves it. Public, no auth.

post.description: Emails a 6-digit code (and a magic link) to the address. No user row is created here — the account is created lazily on the first successful verify, so this can't be used to enumerate users.

post.summary: Verify the code and get an API key
post.description: Exchange `{email, code}` (CLI/agent) or a magic-link `{token}` (browser) for an API key. The first successful email-code verify creates the account. Dashboard Google/GitHub also redeems through this endpoint (`/?token=`). The code expires in 15 minutes and allows 3 attempts.

get.description: Public discovery for widgets and the dashboard. Returns the enabled provider names (`google`, `github`) so pages never hardcode a provider. Empty when neither pair is configured. Sign-in creates or links a `users` row; a hosted-page session still does not disclose an API key.

Apex start. Query `return_to` is required and must be an absolute URL. Two shapes: the dashboard origin `/` (owner purpose — callback hands off via `/?token=`) or a real content-host path (`/{handle}/{sitename}/…`) / DNS-proven custom domain (site purpose — callback issues a host-and-site-scoped session). Success 302s to the provider with PKCE S256. Unknown or disabled provider is 404. No cookie is set here. The caller cannot set `purpose`; it is derived from `return_to`.

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: Absolute URL of the page to return to after sign-in

get.description: Provider redirect URI on the apex. Consumes the one-time `state`. Identifies via userinfo, then `resolveUser` (link or create a `users` row on a verified email; refuse missing/unverified email). Site purpose 302s to `https://<return-host>/v1/visitor/establish?once=…`. Owner purpose 302s to `{PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/?token=…` for the dashboard to redeem via `POST /v1/auth/verify`. Neither redirect contains an API key. Failures are a short no-store HTML page on the apex with no Location and no cookie.

302.description: Site purpose: redirect to /v1/visitor/establish on the stored host. Owner purpose: redirect to /?token= on PUBLIC_BASE_URL.

400.description: Bad, replayed, or expired state, or provider error

get.description: One-time hop on the content host or custom domain. Consumes `once`, host-matches, sets `__Host-sh_vsess` (or `sh_vsess` on local HTTP), then 302s to the stored `return_to` with no query mutation. Never sets a cookie on the apex. Failures are HTML, no cookie, no redirect.

302.description: Cookie set; redirect to the stored return_to

400.description: Bad, replayed, expired, host-mismatch, or apex Host

post.description: Deletes the session named by the visitor cookie and clears the cookie. Requires `X-SH-CSRF: 1` or `Content-Type: application/json` (not a simple form post).

403.description: Missing CSRF header (and not a JSON request)

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's sites. Admins see all sites.

post.summary: Deploy a site from inline JSON files
post.description: The LLM-friendly deploy path — send every file inline in one request, no archiving. `index.html` is required. Relative paths only (`..`/absolute are rejected); secret files (`.env`, `.git/*`, `id_rsa`) are dropped and script extensions (`.sh .py .php …`) are rejected. Use PUT to update an existing site.

put.summary: Update a site from inline JSON files
put.description: Same as POST, but for an existing site you own. Creates a new version and activates it.

post.summary: Create a site from an archive
post.description: Upload a `.tar.gz` or `.zip` (for framework builds, binary assets, large sites). Max 100 MB.

put.summary: Update a site from an archive
put.description: Upload a new version of an existing site you own. Creates a new version and activates it.

delete.description: Deletes the site you own — all versions and files from disk.

put.description: Re-point the live site at an existing version number.

Set whether this site is listed on the owner's public showcase at sites.<domain>/<handle>. `public` = listed on the showcase; `unlisted` = still reachable by direct link but hidden from the showcase. Owner only (API key).

get.description: Owner-scoped daily view and visitor counts derived server-side from the access log (no client beacon). `visitors` are distinct hashed IPs per UTC day — salt rotates daily, so a returning-next-day visitor counts once per day in the range total. `daily` is zero-filled dense for the requested window (oldest → newest). Owner only (API key).

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of UTC days to include (default 30, clamp 1..365)

get.description: Returns the JSON blob for this site (`null` if unset). PUBLIC store — no API key; the server checks `Origin`/`Referer` and only accepts calls from the site's own page (`https://{sitename}.simple-host.app`). The response carries an `ETag`; send `If-None-Match: <etag>` to get a `304` when nothing changed (cheap polling). Never store secrets here.

put.description: Overwrites the whole blob (≤ 1 MB), last-write-wins. Optionally pass `If-Match: <etag>` for optimistic concurrency (returns 412 on conflict). Origin-gated. Writes require a visitor session (`X-SH-CSRF: 1`) or the owner's `X-API-Key`.

patch.description: Apply one or more atomic operations so concurrent writers never clobber. Origin-gated. Writes require a visitor session (`X-SH-CSRF: 1`) or the owner's `X-API-Key`. Ops — `set` (path,value), `inc` (path,by), `append` (path,value), `remove` (path), `removeWhere` (path,match).

get.summary: List collections a site has saved
get.description: Owner-only inventory of named collections on this site, with row count and most-recent write. Empty site returns `{collections:[]}`.

post.summary: Append an item to a collection
post.description: Append-only list (O(1) insert). For signups, RSVPs, submissions. Origin-gated. Writes require a visitor session (`X-SH-CSRF: 1`) or the owner's `X-API-Key`. Each item ≤ 64 KB.

get.description: Newest-first, paginated. Origin-gated (no API key) for the site's own page, or owner/admin API key for the dashboard. Writes (POST) stay Origin-only.
Owner-only. Streams the whole collection (not capped at the public 200-row read limit). Columns are `id`, `created_at`, then the sorted union of JSON keys across all rows.

get.summary: Read per-site JSON state (v3, by handle)
get.description: Returns the JSON blob for this site (`null` if unset). PUBLIC store — no API key; the server checks `Origin`/`Referer` and only accepts calls from the site's own page (`https://{sitename}.simple-host.app`). The response carries an `ETag`; send `If-None-Match: <etag>` to get a `304` when nothing changed (cheap polling). Never store secrets here. v3 user-scoped, path-model-canonical variant: resolves the site by (handle -> user_id) + (user_id, name).

put.summary: Replace per-site JSON state (v3, by handle)
put.description: Overwrites the whole blob (≤ 1 MB), last-write-wins. Optionally pass `If-Match: <etag>` for optimistic concurrency (returns 412 on conflict). Origin-gated. Writes require a visitor session (`X-SH-CSRF: 1`) or the owner's `X-API-Key`. v3 user-scoped, path-model-canonical variant: resolves the site by (handle -> user_id) + (user_id, name).

patch.summary: Atomically update per-site state (v3, by handle)
patch.description: Apply one or more atomic operations so concurrent writers never clobber. Origin-gated. Writes require a visitor session (`X-SH-CSRF: 1`) or the owner's `X-API-Key`. Ops — `set` (path,value), `inc` (path,by), `append` (path,value), `remove` (path), `removeWhere` (path,match). v3 user-scoped, path-model-canonical variant: resolves the site by (handle -> user_id) + (user_id, name).

post.summary: Append an item to a collection (v3, by handle)
post.description: Append-only list (O(1) insert). For signups, RSVPs, submissions. Origin-gated. Writes require a visitor session (`X-SH-CSRF: 1`) or the owner's `X-API-Key`. Each item ≤ 64 KB. v3 user-scoped, path-model-canonical variant: resolves the site by (handle -> user_id) + (user_id, name).

get.summary: List items in a collection (v3, by handle)
get.description: Newest-first, paginated. Origin-gated (no API key) for the site's own page, or owner/admin API key for the dashboard. Writes (POST) stay Origin-only. v3 user-scoped, path-model-canonical variant: resolves the site by (handle -> user_id) + (user_id, name).

put.summary: Admin override — allow anonymous writes on one site
put.description: Sets `sites.allow_anonymous_writes`. Admin (`ADMIN_API_KEY`) only. Default is false. When `WRITE_AUTH_MODE=on` and this flag is true, anonymous writes to this site succeed and are logged with `outcome=overridden`. No `/v1/u/{handle}/…` twin.

put.summary: Set a view password (make the site private)
put.description: Password-protect the whole site (view-lock). Visitors get a custom login page + signed cookie, and the locked page's state/collections also require unlocking. Owner only (API key).

delete.summary: Remove the view password (make the site public again)

put.summary: Allow external origins to use this site's backend
put.description: Whitelist extra origins (scheme://host, no path) that may call this site's state/collections API cross-origin — so a page hosted anywhere (GitHub Pages, Netlify, …) can use the site as its backend for comments, feedback, counters, and forms. Replaces the whole list (max 20). Owner only. Same Origin-gated trust model as same-site calls: data stays public to the page's audience; never store secrets.

post.summary: Bind a custom domain to this site
post.description: Bind ONE custom domain to the site (status starts as `pending`). Returns the DNS CNAME record the owner must create (host → platform CNAME target). Once DNS points at us, on-demand TLS issues a cert and the domain is served at its root. Domains are globally unique; hijacking the platform zone is rejected. Owner only (API key).

409.description: Domain already taken by another site

get.summary: Get the custom domain binding for this site
get.description: Returns the bound domain and status, or `{domain:null,status:null}` when none is set. Includes the CNAME DNS record to add when a domain is bound. Owner only (API key).

delete.summary: Unbind the custom domain from this site
delete.description: Clears the domain binding and removes the serving symlink. Owner only (API key).

get.description: Public. Returns id + title + description for each template.
Public. Returns the template's `files` map, ready to POST to `/v1/sites/{name}/files`.

Admin-only. Returns every registered user with their sites nested (API keys are never included). Powers the /admin dashboard. A signed-in non-admin gets 404, not 403 — the endpoint does not confirm it exists to anyone who may not use it, and /admin renders that as an ordinary not-found page.

200.description: All users with nested sites and totals.

404.description: not an admin (deliberately indistinguishable from a route that does not exist)

post.summary: Transcribe a voice recording to text
post.description: Powers the mic button in the builder chat. POST the raw audio bytes as the body with the recording's Content-Type — WebM/Opus (Chrome) and MP4/AAC (iOS Safari) are both accepted, since browsers disagree and the server sniffs the container itself. Speech-to-text runs on this box (Moonshine, CPU-only), so audio is never sent to a third party. Returns the text for the user to edit and send; it does not start a build. Sign-in-gated and rate limited. Absent when the server has no TRANSCRIBE_URL configured.

200.description: Transcript. Empty text means no speech was detected.

post.summary: Generate a site from a prompt (AI create)
post.description: Powers the home-page "create with AI" chat. Sign-in-gated and rate-limited (spends Anthropic credits). Send the conversation and (optionally) the current HTML and attachments; returns a short reply and, when ready, the HTML. Disabled if the server has no Anthropic key.

html.description: current site HTML, for incremental edits

attachments.description: images / PDFs / text on the latest user turn

200.description: Returns a jobId; poll /v1/generate/status until it reports done. Every backend answers this way. A full build takes a minute or more, which is far too long to hold one HTTP response open — browsers drop an idle connection long before it finishes.

503.description: too many builds already running; retry shortly

get.description: Poll the status of a job started by POST /v1/generate. Returns running until the build finishes, then done with the reply and HTML (or error with a message). Poll every couple of seconds. Sign-in-gated, and a job is visible only to the user who started it — anyone else gets 404, as does an id that has expired. Jobs are kept 10 minutes after finishing.

created.description: true if this verify created the account

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid API key — send the X-API-Key header, not Authorization Bearer

OriginMismatch.description: Origin/Referer does not match the site (or the site is locked)
